user.title: Tuya SL-CE Videolock
user.description:
Connect with your Tuya Cloud project credentials.

**Where to find them**
1. Open your [Tuya Cloud project]({tuya_project_url}) (Overview / Basic Configuration).
2. Copy **Access ID** and **Access Secret**.
3. Choose the **region** that matches the project data center (this project uses **AZ / Americas**).

Also enable: *IoT Core*, *Smart Lock Open Service*, and *IoT Video Live Stream*.

Next step: we will list compatible locks (videolock / smart lock) linked to this project.

data_description.access_id: Client ID / Access ID from the Cloud project overview.
data_description.region: Must match the project data center (AZ → Americas / US).

select_device.title: Select your lock
select_device.description: Found **{device_count}** compatible device(s) (videolock / smart lock categories). Choose the lock to add.

data_description.device_id: Name, category and Device ID from your Tuya Cloud account.

manual_device.title: Enter Device ID
manual_device.description:
Cloud did not return a lock list (Smart Life account may be unlinked, or the list endpoint is empty).

Paste the **Device ID** from the Tuya Cloud console (Devices) or from Smart Life → device → Device Information.

For this apartment the SL-CE is typically `eba0b0f3d9b38977ed8b0a`.

Also confirm the app account is linked under [Cloud project]({tuya_project_url}) → Devices → Link Tuya App Account.

unlock_pin.title: Remote unlock PIN
unlock_pin.description:
Set a **4-digit numeric PIN** required before unlocking this lock from Home Assistant.

The PIN is stored as a one-way hash (not recoverable). **It cannot be changed later** — to use a new PIN, remove this integration and add it again.

data_description.unlock_pin: Exactly four digits (0–9). Required every time someone unlocks remotely in HA.

polling.title: Cloud poll interval
polling.description:
How often Home Assistant asks Tuya Cloud for lock status (battery, online, doorbell, last unlock…).

Default: **{default_seconds}s**. Allowed range: {min_seconds}–{max_seconds}s.

Values under ~5s are more responsive but may hit Tuya rate limits (each poll uses several API calls).

snapshots.title: Doorbell photo retention
snapshots.description:
The integration saves a still from the lock camera on **doorbell**, **unlock/access**, and **security alarm**.

Photos are filed in separate Media Browser folders (Campainha / Acesso liberado / Alarme) and as three **Last photo** entities on the device. Activity logs a text entry pointing there.

Default: **{default_days} days**. Range: {min_days}–{max_days}. Older files are deleted automatically.

data_description.snapshot_retention_days: Days to keep each doorbell snapshot before auto-delete.

abort.already_configured: This Device ID is already configured

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Tuya Cloud — check region and network
error.invalid_auth: Invalid Access ID/Secret, or wrong region
error.device_not_found: Selected device is invalid — go back and try again
error.no_compatible_devices: No videolock / smart lock found in this project. Link the Smart Life account and confirm the device category is supported.

init.title: Poll interval & doorbell photos
init.description:
Cloud poll: default **{default_seconds}s** (range {min_seconds}–{max_seconds}s).

Doorbell photo retention: default **{default_days} days** (range {min_days}–{max_days}). Gallery: Media → Tuya SL-CE Videolock.

The unlock PIN cannot be changed here — remove and re-add the integration to set a new PIN.

data_description.snapshot_retention_days: Days to keep each doorbell snapshot before auto-delete.

unlock_pin_not_configured.message: Unlock PIN is not configured. Remove and re-add the integration to set one.
